brief: Separate a verified local credit-report process from a promise to erase accurate history.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Verify the process"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Verifica el proceso"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Verifique o processo"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Separate a verified local credit-report process from a promise to erase accurate history.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A promise to erase history can distract from a real correction process.
instruction.misconception: A paid promise can guarantee removal of accurate credit history regardless of local rules.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: An error correction checks evidence. A stranger promising guaranteed deletion offers no proof of a legitimate local process.
The verified channel provides a traceable correction process.
A guarantee in an advertisement does not establish legal eligibility.
Independent verification tests the claimed connection to the institution.
The process needs a genuine discrepancy supported by records.
Reporting procedures depend on the relevant local system.
Pressure and guaranteed deletion do not verify a legitimate process.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
